explanation: Requested kinematic point W = 1.2 GeV, Q2 = 1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*) = 0, phi* = 90 deg is physically impossible for eta electroproduction (ep -> e'p eta). The reaction threshold is W_min = m_p + m_eta = 0.938272 + 0.54786 = 1.486132 GeV (constants from exclurad.F). The EtaMAID-2023 hadronic tables used by this code (mpintp.inc) begin at W = 1.4856 GeV, consistent with this threshold. At W = 1.2 GeV there is insufficient invariant mass to produce a proton plus an eta meson, independent of Q2, cos(theta*), or phi*. No EXCLURAD input file was generated. To proceed, choose W >= ~1.487 GeV (e.g. W = 1.5 GeV at the same Q2, cos theta*, phi*).
